text: 仰天大笑出门去，我辈岂是蓬蒿人
pinyin: yǎng tiān dà xiào chū mén qù, wǒ bèi qǐ shì péng hāo rén
literal: look-up · sky · loud · laugh · go-out · door · go, we · [generation] · how · be · wormwood · people
natural: laughing up at the sky I stride out the door; are we the kind to rot among the weeds?

meaning.en: I laugh aloud to the heavens and walk out of the door: people like us were never meant to live and die as nobodies among the weeds.
meaning.zh: 仰头向天大笑着走出家门：像我们这样的人，怎么会是默默无闻、埋没草野的人呢？表现得意和自信。

equivalents: I was not born to live in obscurity
my time has come

examples.zh: 接到录取通知书那天，他仰天大笑出门去，我辈岂是蓬蒿人。
examples.en: The day the offer letter arrived, he laughed up at the sky: people like me are not meant to stay nobodies.

examples.zh: 创业失败后他没有消沉，常念着“仰天大笑出门去，我辈岂是蓬蒿人”给自己打气。
examples.en: After his start-up failed he did not sink; he often cheered himself on with 'I laugh to the heavens and walk out: people like us are no mere weeds'.

story.en: Li Bai wrote this on leaving his children at Nanling in 742 when summoned to the capital by Emperor Xuanzong. The two lines close the poem, brimming with elation.
story.zh: 天宝初年李白接到唐玄宗征召，离开南陵家中的儿女赴长安，临行作此诗，这两句是全诗结尾，意气风发。

usage.en: Quoted for confident, high-spirited moments, such as setting out to make a name. 蓬蒿人 means an obscure commoner.
usage.zh: 用于意气风发、自信出发的时刻；蓬蒿人指埋没草野的平民。

text: 今人不见古时月，今月曾经照古人
pinyin: jīn rén bù jiàn gǔ shí yuè, jīn yuè céng jīng zhào gǔ rén
literal: present · people · not · see · ancient · time · moon, present · moon · once · shine-on · ancient · people
natural: people today never see the moon of old, yet today's moon once shone on the ancients

meaning.en: We today cannot see the moon of ancient times, yet this same moon once shone on the people of the past: human generations pass, the moon endures.
meaning.zh: 今天的人看不到古时的月亮，但今天的月亮曾经照过古人。感叹人生短暂，明月永恒。

equivalents: the same moon shone on those long gone
generations pass, the moon remains

examples.zh: 站在古城墙上，她想起“今人不见古时月，今月曾经照古人”。
examples.en: Standing on the ancient city wall, she thought of 'we cannot see the moon of old, yet this moon once shone on the ancients'.

examples.zh: 博物馆里的老月饼模具让他念出了“今人不见古时月，今月曾经照古人”。
examples.en: The old mooncake moulds in the museum made him recite 'today's people never see the ancient moon, yet today's moon once shone on the ancients'.

story.en: Li Bai's 'Raising a Cup to Ask the Moon' asks where the moon comes from and who first saw it; these lines follow the thought that people come and go like flowing water while the moon is shared across time.
story.zh: 李白《把酒问月》（故人贾淳令予问之）借问月抒怀，这两句说古今之人都共对一轮明月，感叹人生易逝而明月长存。

usage.en: Quoted when reflecting on history, time and the permanence of nature.
usage.zh: 用于感慨历史、时间和自然的永恒。

text: 十步杀一人，千里不留行
pinyin: shí bù shā yī rén, qiān lǐ bù liú xíng
literal: ten · paces · kill · one · man, thousand · miles · not · leave · trace
natural: one man slain every ten paces, and no trace left in a thousand miles

meaning.en: Describes the swordsman-knight: he kills one foe every ten paces and sweeps through a thousand miles without stopping or leaving a trace.
meaning.zh: 形容侠客剑术高超、行动迅猛：每走十步就杀一人，千里奔行不停留、不留踪迹。

equivalents: slay a man every ten paces
come and go without a trace

examples.zh: 武侠小说里常用“十步杀一人，千里不留行”形容剑客的身手。
examples.en: Martial-arts novels often use 'a man slain every ten paces, no trace in a thousand miles' to describe a swordsman's skill.

examples.zh: 这位前锋突破防线，真有几分“十步杀一人，千里不留行”的气势。
examples.en: The striker cut through the defence with something of the air of 'one foe felled every ten paces, no trace left in a thousand miles'.

story.en: The opening of Li Bai's 'Ballad of the Knight-errant', in praise of chivalry. After the deed the knight 'brushes off his robe and goes, hiding his name' (事了拂衣去，深藏身与名).
story.zh: 李白《侠客行》赞颂游侠，这是诗中描写侠客的名句，后面接“事了拂衣去，深藏身与名”。

usage.en: Quoted to describe swift, formidable martial prowess, often playfully in sport or fiction. The next line is 事了拂衣去，深藏身与名.
usage.zh: 形容武艺高强、来去如风，常带玩笑口吻；下句为“事了拂衣去，深藏身与名”。

text: 即从巴峡穿巫峡，便下襄阳向洛阳
pinyin: jí cóng bā xiá chuān wū xiá, biàn xià xiāng yáng xiàng luò yáng
literal: at-once · from · Ba · gorge · pass-through · Wu · gorge, then · descend · Xiangyang · head-for · Luoyang
natural: straight from Ba Gorge through Wu Gorge, then down to Xiangyang and on to Luoyang

meaning.en: In a rush of joy: we shall go straight through the Ba and Wu gorges, then down to Xiangyang and on toward Luoyang, home at last.
meaning.zh: 喜讯传来，诗人想象立刻穿过巴峡、巫峡，再下襄阳直奔洛阳，归心似箭。

equivalents: homeward bound at last
a journey home in one breath

examples.zh: 拿到回国机票的那一刻，他想起“即从巴峡穿巫峡，便下襄阳向洛阳”的畅快。
examples.en: When he got his ticket home, he felt the exhilaration of 'straight through the Ba and Wu gorges, then down to Xiangyang and Luoyang'.

examples.zh: 春运的火车上，游子心里默念“即从巴峡穿巫峡，便下襄阳向洛阳”。
examples.en: On the Spring Festival train, the traveller murmured 'through Ba Gorge and Wu Gorge, then down to Xiangyang and Luoyang'.

origin.source: 杜甫《闻官军收河南河北》

story.en: Du Fu wrote this in 763 on hearing that government forces had retaken Henan and Hebei, ending the An Lushan rebellion; the lines imagine his journey home, with the poem's famous opening 'news from beyond the sword-pass' (剑外忽传收蓟北).
story.zh: 763年官军收复河南河北，安史之乱将平，杜甫闻讯狂喜，写下此诗，这两句想象返乡的路线。

usage.en: Quoted for the joy of heading home, or of a quick, unimpeded journey. Note that 巴峡 and 巫峡 are in the Yangtze gorges.
usage.zh: 用于表达归家的喜悦或一路顺畅的旅程。

text: 人生不相见，动如参与商
pinyin: rén shēng bù xiāng jiàn, dòng rú shēn yǔ shāng
literal: life · not · mutually · see, often · like · Shen · and · Shang
natural: in life friends so often do not meet, like the stars Shen and Shang

meaning.en: In a lifetime friends often cannot meet, like the stars Shen and Shang, which never appear in the sky together.
meaning.zh: 人生在世，朋友常常无法相见，就像参星与商星，此出彼没，永不同现。

equivalents: ships that pass in the night
never able to meet, like the two stars

examples.zh: 毕业二十年才重聚，他感叹“人生不相见，动如参与商”。
examples.en: Reunited after twenty years, he sighed, 'in life we so seldom meet, like the stars Shen and Shang'.

examples.zh: 远隔重洋的老友多年未见，真是“人生不相见，动如参与商”。
examples.en: With an old friend an ocean away unseen for years, it is truly 'like the stars Shen and Shang'.

story.en: Du Fu's 759 poem on meeting his old friend Wei after some twenty years. Shen (in Orion) and Shang (Antares) are never in the sky at the same time.
story.zh: 杜甫759年重逢二十年未见的旧友卫八处士，开篇即写此句；参星在西、商星在东，此出彼没。

usage.en: Note the pronunciation 参 shēn (the star Orion's belt), not cān. Quoted when friends are long apart. 参商 alone also means estranged.
usage.zh: 注意参读shēn（参星）。常用于老友久别难见；“参商”也指彼此隔绝。

text: 黄四娘家花满蹊，千朵万朵压枝低
pinyin: huáng sì niáng jiā huā mǎn xī, qiān duǒ wàn duǒ yā zhī dī
literal: Huang · fourth · lady · home · flowers · fill · lane, thousand · blossoms · ten-thousand · blossoms · press · branch · low
natural: Lady Huang's lane is full of flowers, thousands upon thousands weighing the branches down

meaning.en: A cheerful spring picture: flowers fill the path by Fourth Lady Huang's house, blossoms in their thousands bending the branches low.
meaning.zh: 描绘春天景象：黄四娘家的小路上开满鲜花，成千上万朵花把枝条压得低垂。

equivalents: a riot of blossom
branches bowed beneath the flowers

examples.zh: 公园里樱花盛开，真是“黄四娘家花满蹊，千朵万朵压枝低”。
examples.en: The cherry blossom in the park is in full bloom: 'flowers fill the lane, thousands bending the boughs low'.

examples.zh: 春天去乡下，农家小院里“黄四娘家花满蹊，千朵万朵压枝低”。
examples.en: Going to the countryside in spring, the farmyard is a scene of 'Lady Huang's lane full of flowers, boughs bowed low'.

story.en: From the seven quatrains Du Fu wrote while strolling by the river near his Chengdu cottage; this is the sixth, and Lady Huang was his neighbour.
story.zh: 杜甫居成都草堂时沿江散步赏花，作《江畔独步寻花》七绝七首，此为其六，黄四娘是他的邻居。

usage.en: Quoted for lush spring flowers. 蹊 (xī) is a small path. A line from the series of seven quatrains Du Fu wrote near his Chengdu thatched cottage.
usage.zh: 形容春花盛开。蹊指小路。

text: 正是江南好风景，落花时节又逢君
pinyin: zhèng shì jiāng nán hǎo fēng jǐng, luò huā shí jié yòu féng jūn
literal: just · be · Jiangnan · fine · scenery, falling · flowers · season · again · meet · you
natural: it is just the fair scenery of the south, and in the season of falling blossom I meet you again

meaning.en: Here in Jiangnan the scenery is at its loveliest, yet it is the season of falling blossom that I meet you again: a bittersweet reunion of two worn-down old men.
meaning.zh: 江南风光正好，却在落花的暮春时节再次遇见你；字面写景，实含世事沧桑、重逢感伤之意。

equivalents: a bittersweet reunion
meeting again as the blossom falls

examples.zh: 异乡偶遇多年未见的老同学，他想到“正是江南好风景，落花时节又逢君”。
examples.en: Meeting an old classmate by chance in a strange city, he thought of 'fair Jiangnan scenery, and we meet again as the blossom falls'.

examples.zh: 演出结束后老艺术家们重逢，台上的人说起“正是江南好风景，落花时节又逢君”，满座动容。
examples.en: When the veteran artists reunited after the show, one quoted 'fair Jiangnan scenery, and we meet again as the blossom falls', and everyone was moved.

story.en: Written in 770 when Du Fu, old and ill, met the court singer Li Guinian in Tanzhou. Both had seen better days before the An Lushan rebellion.
story.zh: 770年杜甫漂泊潭州，遇见当年名噪一时的乐工李龟年，二人皆历尽安史之乱后的沧桑。

usage.en: Often quoted at reunions with a tinge of sorrow; 落花时节 hints at decline and the passing of an era.
usage.zh: 常用于带伤感的重逢；落花时节暗含衰落与时代变迁。

text: 春草明年绿，王孙归不归
pinyin: chūn cǎo míng nián lǜ, wáng sūn guī bù guī
literal: spring · grass · next · year · green, prince's · grandson · return · not · return
natural: the spring grass will be green again next year, but will you come back?

meaning.en: The spring grass will grow green again next year, but will my friend, the wanderer, be back?
meaning.zh: 明年春草又会变绿，远行的朋友你会不会回来呢？表达送别时的牵挂。

equivalents: will you be back when the grass is green again?

examples.zh: 机场送别时，他只说了一句“春草明年绿，王孙归不归”。
examples.en: At the airport he said only one line: 'The grass will be green next year; will you return?'

examples.zh: 毕业赠言里有人写下“春草明年绿，王孙归不归”。
examples.en: One person wrote 'the spring grass will be green next year: will you come back?' in a graduation message.

story.en: Wang Wei's quatrain (also titled 'Seeing a friend off in the mountains') ends with this couplet, after '山中相送罢，日暮掩柴扉' (parting done, at dusk I close the brushwood gate).
story.zh: 王维的送别小诗，前两句为“山中相送罢，日暮掩柴扉”，此为结句，化用《楚辞·招隐士》。

usage.en: Quoted at partings. 王孙 originally means a nobleman's descendant and here is a polite address for a friend. Echoes the Chu ci line 王孙游兮不归，春草生兮萋萋.
usage.zh: 用于送别；王孙在此是对友人的尊称，化用《楚辞·招隐士》。

text: 坐观垂钓者，徒有羡鱼情
pinyin: zuò guān chuí diào zhě, tú yǒu xiàn yú qíng
literal: sit · watch · dangle · fish · person, in-vain · have · envy · fish · feeling
natural: sitting watching the anglers, I only envy their catch

meaning.en: Sitting watching the anglers, I can only feel the longing for fish: I want to take office but have no one to recommend me.
meaning.zh: 坐着看别人钓鱼，只能白白羡慕他们钓到鱼。诗人借此表达想出仕却无人引荐的心情。

equivalents: to look on enviously from the sidelines
all dressed up with nowhere to go

examples.zh: 看着同学们拿到了心仪的offer，他不禁叹道“坐观垂钓者，徒有羡鱼情”。
examples.en: Seeing classmates land their dream offers, he sighed, 'I sit watching the anglers, with only the longing for fish'.

examples.zh: 没有行动，只会“坐观垂钓者，徒有羡鱼情”，什么也得不到。
examples.en: If you do not act and only 'sit watching the anglers, envying their fish', you gain nothing.

origin.source: 孟浩然《望洞庭湖赠张丞相》

story.en: Meng Haoran addressed this poem to Prime Minister Zhang (Zhang Jiuling), hoping for a recommendation. The couplet echoes the old saying 临河而羡鱼，不如归家织网 (rather than envy the fish, go home and weave a net).
story.zh: 孟浩然赠张九龄（张丞相）求引荐之作，结尾化用《淮南子》“临河而羡鱼，不如归家织网”的意思。

usage.en: A polite way of asking for patronage in the original; today used for envy without action. Compare the derived idiom 临渊羡鱼.
usage.zh: 原诗是含蓄的求仕之语，今多指只羡慕而不行动。参见成语“临渊羡鱼”。

text: 春寒赐浴华清池，温泉水滑洗凝脂
pinyin: chūn hán cì yù huá qīng chí, wēn quán shuǐ huá xǐ níng zhī
literal: spring · chill · bestow · bathe · Huaqing · Pool, hot · spring · water · smooth · wash · congealed · fat
natural: in the spring chill she was bidden to bathe at Huaqing Pool, the smooth hot spring washing her skin like congealed cream

meaning.en: On a chilly spring day she was granted a bath in the Huaqing Pool; the smooth hot-spring water washed over her skin, as white and soft as congealed fat.
meaning.zh: 春寒料峭之时，皇帝赐杨贵妃在华清池沐浴，温泉水滑，洗着她白嫩如凝脂的肌肤。

equivalents: skin like cream

examples.zh: 导游在华清池边朗诵“春寒赐浴华清池，温泉水滑洗凝脂”。
examples.en: At the Huaqing Pool the guide recited 'in the spring chill she was granted a bath, the smooth hot spring washing her creamy skin'.

examples.zh: 讲到杨贵妃时，老师引了“春寒赐浴华清池，温泉水滑洗凝脂”。
examples.en: Speaking of Yang Guifei, the teacher quoted 'in the spring chill she was bidden to bathe at Huaqing Pool'.

story.en: From Bai Juyi's long narrative poem on the love of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei (806); this couplet recalls her favoured days at the Huaqing hot springs.
story.zh: 白居易《长恨歌》写唐玄宗与杨贵妃的爱情悲剧，此联追叙杨贵妃受宠时在华清池沐浴。

usage.en: Describes Yang Guifei's bath; 凝脂 'congealed fat' is a classical image for fair, smooth skin. Commonly quoted at the Huaqing Pool hot springs near Xi'an.
usage.zh: 描写杨贵妃沐浴华清池；凝脂喻皮肤白嫩滑润。常在西安华清池景区被引用。

text: 长恨春归无觅处，不知转入此中来
pinyin: cháng hèn chūn guī wú mì chù, bù zhī zhuǎn rù cǐ zhōng lái
literal: long · regret · spring · return · no · seek · place, not · know · turn · enter · this · within · come
natural: I always lamented that spring had gone, nowhere to be found; I never knew it had turned up here

meaning.en: I used to lament that spring had left with nowhere to be found; I never guessed it had slipped away to hide here among the mountain temple's peach blossoms.
meaning.zh: 我常常惋惜春天归去无处寻觅，却不知它悄悄转到这山寺里来了。表现意外发现春色的惊喜。

equivalents: spring, thought lost, turns up unexpectedly

examples.zh: 四月的高山上桃花仍盛，他笑道：“长恨春归无觅处，不知转入此中来。”
examples.en: The peach trees were still in bloom high in the mountains in April, and he laughed, 'I lamented spring was lost, not knowing it had come here'.

examples.zh: 她在老屋后院发现了一树花，想起“长恨春归无觅处，不知转入此中来”。
examples.en: Finding a tree in blossom in the old house's backyard, she thought of 'I lamented spring was gone, never knowing it had come here'.

story.en: Written by Bai Juyi in 817 (April): while the plains had lost their blossom, he found peach flowers still blooming at Dalin Temple on Mount Lu; the poem opens '人间四月芳菲尽，山寺桃花始盛开'.
story.zh: 817年四月白居易游庐山大林寺，山下芳菲已尽，山上桃花却才盛开，诗的开头是“人间四月芳菲尽，山寺桃花始盛开”。

usage.en: Quoted for a pleasant surprise of finding spring or something lost. Note: 踏破铁鞋无觅处 is a different line.
usage.zh: 用于意外发现春色或失而复得的惊喜。

text: 一道残阳铺水中，半江瑟瑟半江红
pinyin: yī dào cán yáng pū shuǐ zhōng, bàn jiāng sè sè bàn jiāng hóng
literal: one · ray · remaining · sun · spread · water · in, half · river · emerald · half · river · red
natural: a ray of the setting sun spreads on the water, half the river emerald, half the river red

meaning.en: A last shaft of sunlight spreads over the water, turning half the river a deep emerald-green and half of it red.
meaning.zh: 一道夕阳的余晖铺在江面上，江水一半呈碧绿色，一半被映得通红。

equivalents: a river half green, half red in the sunset

examples.zh: 黄昏的湖面上，真是“一道残阳铺水中，半江瑟瑟半江红”。
examples.en: On the lake at dusk it was just 'a ray of sunset spread on the water, half the river green, half red'.

examples.zh: 摄影展上那幅《暮江》，配的就是“一道残阳铺水中，半江瑟瑟半江红”。
examples.en: The photograph 'Dusk on the River' at the exhibition was captioned 'a ray of the setting sun on the water, half green, half red'.

story.en: Bai Juyi's short poem of 822-3 on the Yangtze at dusk and the moon rising; it is a textbook model of colour contrast.
story.zh: 白居易外放途中所作，写暮色中江景和月升，色彩对比鲜明，是教材常选篇目。

usage.en: Quoted for river scenes at sunset. 瑟瑟 here means a deep blue-green, not 'trembling'.
usage.zh: 用于描写江面落日景色；瑟瑟在此指碧绿色。

text: 文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作
pinyin: wén zhāng hé wéi shí ér zhù, gē shī hé wéi shì ér zuò
literal: essays · ought · for · times · and · write, songs · poems · ought · for · affairs · and · compose
natural: essays ought to be written for their times, poems and songs composed for the events of the day

meaning.en: Prose should be written for the sake of its times, and verse composed to address real events: literature must engage with reality.
meaning.zh: 文章应当为时代而写，诗歌应当为现实之事而作。主张文学要反映现实、有的放矢。

equivalents: literature must speak to its age
write for the times

examples.zh: 评论家引用“文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作”，批评脱离现实的创作。
examples.en: The critic quoted 'essays should be written for the times and poems for the events of the day' to criticise writing divorced from reality.

examples.zh: 这位记者始终相信“文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作”。
examples.en: The reporter has always believed that 'writing should be for the times, poetry for its events'.

story.en: From Bai Juyi's letter of 815 to his friend Yuan Zhen (Yuan Jiu), the manifesto of the New Yuefu movement, which urged poetry to reflect social realities.
story.zh: 815年白居易写给好友元稹（元九）的书信，是新乐府运动的理论纲领，主张诗歌反映社会现实。

usage.en: Used in discussions of literature and journalism engaging with society. The slogan of the New Yuefu movement.
usage.zh: 用于讨论文学、新闻要关注社会现实；是新乐府运动的纲领。

text: 人世几回伤往事，山形依旧枕寒流
pinyin: rén shì jǐ huí shāng wǎng shì, shān xíng yī jiù zhěn hán liú
literal: human · world · how-many · times · grieve-over · past · events, mountain · shape · as-before · pillow · cold · current
natural: how many times has the world mourned the past, yet the mountain still rests as ever on the cold river

meaning.en: How many times have people grieved over past events, while the mountain still lies, as it always did, pillowed against the cold river.
meaning.zh: 世人曾多少次为往事伤感，可山河依然如旧，山势依旧枕着寒冷的江流。感叹兴亡无常而山川不变。

equivalents: the world changes, the hills remain

examples.zh: 站在古战场遗址上，他念起“人世几回伤往事，山形依旧枕寒流”。
examples.en: Standing on the old battlefield, he recited 'how often the world has grieved over the past, yet the hills still lie by the cold river'.

examples.zh: 历史课上老师以“人世几回伤往事，山形依旧枕寒流”结束了对三国的讲述。
examples.en: The teacher ended the lesson on the Three Kingdoms with 'the world has grieved many times over the past, yet the mountains still pillow on the cold stream'.

story.en: Liu Yuxi wrote this around 824 at Xisai Mountain (in today's Hubei), where Wu's chain across the river failed against Western Jin ships, a symbol of the fall of kingdoms.
story.zh: 刘禹锡经过西塞山，追忆西晋灭东吴的往事，借山河依旧感叹六朝兴亡。

usage.en: Quoted for the contrast between enduring landscape and passing dynasties. Literary.
usage.zh: 用于感叹历史兴亡、山川依旧。

text: 巴山楚水凄凉地，二十三年弃置身
pinyin: bā shān chǔ shuǐ qī liáng dì, èr shí sān nián qì zhì shēn
literal: Ba · mountains · Chu · waters · desolate · place, twenty · three · years · cast-aside · self
natural: the desolate hills of Ba and rivers of Chu, and a body cast aside for twenty-three years

meaning.en: In the bleak land of the Ba mountains and Chu rivers, I was cast aside for twenty-three years.
meaning.zh: 在巴山楚水这荒凉偏远的地方，我被朝廷抛弃了二十三年。

equivalents: twenty-three years in the wilderness

examples.zh: 被调到边远地区工作多年的他，念起“巴山楚水凄凉地，二十三年弃置身”，感慨万千。
examples.en: Posted for years to a remote region, he recited 'the desolate Ba mountains and Chu waters, twenty-three years cast aside', deeply moved.

examples.zh: 老教授回顾被下放的岁月，引用了“巴山楚水凄凉地，二十三年弃置身”。
examples.en: The old professor, recalling his years in exile, quoted 'desolate Ba and Chu, twenty-three years cast aside'.

origin.source: 刘禹锡《酬乐天扬州初逢席上见赠》

story.en: Liu Yuxi, banished for 23 years after the failed reform of 805, met Bai Juyi at Yangzhou in 826 and replied to Bai's poem with this one.
story.zh: 刘禹锡因永贞革新失败被贬二十三年，826年在扬州与白居易相逢，作此诗酬答。

usage.en: Quoted for long years of banishment or neglect. The next couplet is 沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春.
usage.zh: 用于形容长年被贬或被冷落；下联为“沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春”。

text: 山回路转不见君，雪上空留马行处
pinyin: shān huí lù zhuǎn bù jiàn jūn, xuě shàng kōng liú mǎ xíng chù
literal: mountain · bend · road · turn · not · see · you, snow · on · empty · leave · horse · walk · place
natural: the mountain curves, the road turns, and you are out of sight; only hoofprints remain in the snow

meaning.en: The mountain bends and the road turns, and I can no longer see you: only your horse's tracks are left in the snow.
meaning.zh: 山势回环，道路转弯，再也看不见你的身影，雪地上只留下马蹄走过的痕迹。

equivalents: only your tracks remain in the snow

examples.zh: 送走朋友后，他望着雪地里的脚印想起“山回路转不见君，雪上空留马行处”。
examples.en: After seeing his friend off, he looked at the footprints in the snow and thought of 'the road turns and you are gone, only hoofprints left in the snow'.

examples.zh: 毕业送别的那个冬天，同学们念起了“山回路转不见君，雪上空留马行处”。
examples.en: In the winter of the graduation farewell, the classmates recited 'the hills turn and you are lost to sight, only hoofprints in the snow'.

origin.source: 岑参《白雪歌送武判官归京》

story.en: Cen Shen wrote this at a frontier camp at Luntai (Xinjiang) when seeing off Judge Wu back to the capital; it is the same poem as '忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开'.
story.zh: 岑参在西域轮台送武判官回京时所作，与“忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开”同出一首。

usage.en: Quoted at partings, especially in winter, for the emptiness after a friend leaves.
usage.zh: 用于送别，尤其是冬日送友离去后的怅惘。

text: 云横秦岭家何在，雪拥蓝关马不前
pinyin: yún héng qín lǐng jiā hé zài, xuě yōng lán guān mǎ bù qián
literal: clouds · lie-across · Qin · Range · home · where · be, snow · bank-up · Lan · Pass · horse · not · advance
natural: clouds lie across the Qinling, where is my home? Snow bars the Lan Pass and my horse will not advance

meaning.en: Clouds lie across the Qinling Mountains, and where is my home? Snow blocks Lan Pass and my horse cannot go forward: a picture of an exile's despair.
meaning.zh: 浓云横亘秦岭，家在何方？大雪拥塞蓝关，马也停步不前。写出被贬路上的凄凉。

equivalents: stranded far from home
at a dead end in a snowstorm

examples.zh: 暴风雪中困在半路，他苦笑着念出“云横秦岭家何在，雪拥蓝关马不前”。
examples.en: Stuck halfway in a blizzard, he gave a wry smile and recited 'clouds lie across the Qinling, snow bars the Lan Pass, my horse will not move'.

examples.zh: 春运遇上大雪封路，朋友圈里全是“云横秦岭家何在，雪拥蓝关马不前”。
examples.en: When snow closed the roads at Spring Festival, social media filled with 'clouds across the Qinling, where is home? Snow bars the pass'.

origin.source: 韩愈《左迁至蓝关示侄孙湘》

story.en: Han Yu was banished to Chaozhou in 819 for memorialising against welcoming a Buddha relic; this poem was written on the way at Lan Pass, shown to his grandnephew Han Xiang.
story.zh: 819年韩愈因上书谏迎佛骨被贬潮州，行至蓝关，作此诗赠侄孙韩湘。

usage.en: Quoted for being stuck on a journey, especially in bad weather, or for political setback. Often used jokingly about travel disruption.
usage.zh: 用于路途受阻，尤其是恶劣天气，或仕途失意；也常用来戏说出行受阻。

text: 报君黄金台上意，提携玉龙为君死
pinyin: bào jūn huáng jīn tái shàng yì, tí xié yù lóng wèi jūn sǐ
literal: repay · lord · Gold · Terrace · on · intent, grasp · jade · dragon · for · lord · die
natural: to repay the favour shown on the Gold Terrace, I bear my jade-dragon sword and die for my lord

meaning.en: To repay my lord's trust, as shown at the Gold Terrace, I take up my sword and am ready to die for him.
meaning.zh: 为报答君王在黄金台上礼遇贤士的恩意，我提着宝剑愿为君王效死。

equivalents: to lay down one's life in gratitude for a lord's trust

examples.zh: 面对知遇之恩，他念起“报君黄金台上意，提携玉龙为君死”。
examples.en: Moved by the trust placed in him, he recalled 'to repay the favour of the Gold Terrace I will take up my sword and die for my lord'.

examples.zh: 军旅题材的歌曲里引用了“报君黄金台上意，提携玉龙为君死”。
examples.en: The military-themed song quotes 'to repay the Gold Terrace's trust, I take my sword and die for my lord'.

story.en: Li He's poem on a beleaguered frontier garrison, which opens with '黑云压城城欲摧，甲光向日金鳞开'; this is its closing couplet, alluding to King Zhao of Yan's Gold Terrace, built to recruit talent.
story.zh: 李贺《雁门太守行》描写边城被围的战斗，开头为“黑云压城城欲摧，甲光向日金鳞开”，此为结尾，用燕昭王筑黄金台招贤之典。

usage.en: Expresses loyalty and readiness to sacrifice for someone who values you; 黄金台 recalls King Zhao of Yan recruiting talent with gold. 玉龙 means a sword.
usage.zh: 表达知遇之恩、愿效死力；黄金台指燕昭王筑台招贤，玉龙指宝剑。

text: 鸟宿池边树，僧敲月下门
pinyin: niǎo sù chí biān shù, sēng qiāo yuè xià mén
literal: birds · roost · pond · side · trees, monk · knock · moon · under · door
natural: birds roost in the trees by the pond; a monk knocks at the gate under the moon

meaning.en: Birds roost in the trees beside the pond, and a monk knocks at a door in the moonlight: a still night scene in which a single sound makes the silence deeper.
meaning.zh: 鸟儿栖息在池边的树上，月光下僧人敲着门。以动衬静，写出夜的幽静。

equivalents: a knock in the silent moonlit night

examples.zh: 先生评这两句时说，“鸟宿池边树，僧敲月下门”以敲门声衬出夜之静。
examples.en: The teacher said of 'birds roost by the pond, a monk knocks under the moon' that the sound of the knock sets off the stillness of the night.

examples.zh: 作文里引用“鸟宿池边树，僧敲月下门”，描写山寺的夜晚。
examples.en: The essay quotes 'birds roost in the trees by the pond, a monk knocks at the gate under the moon' to describe a mountain temple at night.

story.en: Jia Dao could not decide between 僧推月下门 and 僧敲月下门; he ran into the procession of Han Yu, who advised 敲, giving rise to the idiom 推敲.
story.zh: 相传贾岛骑驴吟诗，拿不准用“推”还是“敲”，冲撞了韩愈的仪仗，韩愈建议用“敲”，“推敲”一词由此而来。

usage.en: The origin of the idiom 推敲 (to weigh one's words): Jia Dao hesitated between 推 'push' and 敲 'knock'. Quoted for tranquil night scenes.
usage.zh: 成语“推敲”由此而来：贾岛在“推”与“敲”之间反复斟酌。

text: 时来天地皆同力，运去英雄不自由
pinyin: shí lái tiān dì jiē tóng lì, yùn qù yīng xióng bù zì yóu
literal: time · come · heaven · earth · all · together · strength, fortune · go · hero · not · free
natural: when the time comes heaven and earth lend their strength; when fortune goes even a hero is not his own master

meaning.en: When the time is right, heaven and earth all help; when fortune has turned, even a hero is not free to do as he wishes.
meaning.zh: 时机来了，天地都来帮忙；运势一去，连英雄也身不由己。强调时运的重要。

equivalents: when luck runs out even heroes are helpless
there is a tide in the affairs of men

examples.zh: 创业成败与时机有关，正所谓“时来天地皆同力，运去英雄不自由”。
examples.en: Success in business depends on timing: as the saying goes, 'when the time comes heaven and earth help; when luck goes even heroes are not free'.

examples.zh: 输掉决赛后，教练感叹“时来天地皆同力，运去英雄不自由”。
examples.en: After losing the final the coach sighed, 'when the time is right heaven and earth help, when luck goes heroes are powerless'.

story.en: Luo Yin wrote this at the Chouebi post-station in Sichuan, where Zhuge Liang planned his northern campaigns; the lines lament that even a hero like Zhuge Liang could not succeed against fate.
story.zh: 罗隐经过四川筹笔驿（诸葛亮北伐筹划军机处），感叹诸葛亮虽才略过人，终未能逆转天命。

usage.en: Quoted about the role of luck and timing; sometimes as consolation, sometimes as an excuse.
usage.zh: 常用来说明时运的作用，既可作安慰，也可作推托之辞。

text: 还君明珠双泪垂，恨不相逢未嫁时
pinyin: huán jūn míng zhū shuāng lèi chuí, hèn bù xiāng féng wèi jià shí
literal: return · you · bright · pearls · both · tears · fall, regret · not · meet · not-yet · married · time
natural: I return your bright pearls with tears streaming down; I only regret we did not meet before I was married

meaning.en: I give back your bright pearls with tears streaming down my face: my only regret is that we did not meet before I married.
meaning.zh: 把你送的明珠还给你，泪流双行；遗憾的是我们没有在我出嫁之前相遇。表达爱而不得的无奈。

equivalents: too late, we met too late
if only we had met sooner

examples.zh: 电影里女主角念着“还君明珠双泪垂，恨不相逢未嫁时”，令人动容。
examples.en: In the film the heroine murmurs 'I return your pearls in tears, regretting we did not meet before my marriage', which is very moving.

examples.zh: 小说结尾，她含泪念道：“还君明珠双泪垂，恨不相逢未嫁时。”
examples.en: At the end of the novel she recites in tears, 'I return your pearls with streaming eyes, regretting we met too late'.

story.en: Zhang Ji wrote in the voice of a married woman who rejects a suitor's gift; the subtitle is 寄东平李司空师道, and it is generally read as his polite refusal of the warlord Li Shidao's recruitment.
story.zh: 张籍以已婚女子口吻写拒绝他人赠珠，题下注“寄东平李司空师道”，一般认为是婉拒藩镇李师道的拉拢。

usage.en: Quoted for love that comes too late; 恨不相逢未嫁时 is also often used alone (and for “if only we had met earlier”). The poem is read allegorically as a refusal of a warlord's offer.
usage.zh: 用于相识太晚、爱而不能；“恨不相逢未嫁时”常单独引用。此诗也被理解为婉拒藩镇拉拢的寓意之作。

text: 回乐峰前沙似雪，受降城外月如霜
pinyin: huí lè fēng qián shā sì xuě, shòu xiáng chéng wài yuè rú shuāng
literal: Huile · peak · front · sand · like · snow, Shouxiang · city · outside · moon · like · frost
natural: before Huile Peak the sand is like snow; outside Shouxiang City the moonlight is like frost

meaning.en: In front of Huile Peak the desert sand gleams like snow, and beyond the Shouxiang fortress the moon is as cold as frost.
meaning.zh: 回乐烽前的沙地白得像雪，受降城外的月光冷得像霜。写出边塞夜晚的清冷荒凉。

equivalents: sand like snow, moonlight like frost

examples.zh: 沙漠夜里月色皎洁，他想起“回乐峰前沙似雪，受降城外月如霜”。
examples.en: On a bright desert night he thought of 'before Huile Peak the sand is like snow, outside Shouxiang the moon is like frost'.

examples.zh: 摄影展的西北专题里，配了“回乐峰前沙似雪，受降城外月如霜”。
examples.en: The north-west section of the photo exhibition was captioned 'sand like snow, moon like frost'.

story.en: Li Yi's frontier quatrain: the soldiers hear a flute at night and long for home, closing with 不知何处吹芦管，一夜征人尽望乡.
story.zh: 李益的边塞绝句，戍边将士夜闻笛声而思乡，结句为“不知何处吹芦管，一夜征人尽望乡”。

usage.en: Quoted for cold desert moonlit scenes. In some editions 峰 is written 烽 (beacon); 峰 is the usual form in anthologies.
usage.zh: 用于描写清冷的塞外月夜；有的版本“峰”作“烽”。

variants: 回乐烽前沙似雪，受降城外月如霜

text: 起舞弄清影，何似在人间
pinyin: qǐ wǔ nòng qīng yǐng, hé sì zài rén jiān
literal: rise · dance · play-with · clear · shadow, how · compare · be-in · human · world
natural: I rise to dance, playing with my clear shadow; how could that compare with the human world?

meaning.en: I rise to dance and sport with my own clear shadow in the moonlight; it is nothing like being in the mortal world, yet is the heavens any better?
meaning.zh: 起身舞蹈，和月光下清朗的身影玩耍，这怎么比得上在人间呢？表达对天上和人间的取舍。

equivalents: dancing alone with one's shadow

examples.zh: 独自在月光下散步，他轻声念着“起舞弄清影，何似在人间”。
examples.en: Walking alone in the moonlight, he softly recited 'I rise to dance with my clear shadow, how would it compare with the human world?'

examples.zh: 中秋晚会的独舞节目就以“起舞弄清影，何似在人间”为主题。
examples.en: The solo dance at the Mid-Autumn gala took 'dancing with my clear shadow, what compares with the mortal world' as its theme.

origin.source: 苏轼《水调歌头·明月几时有》

story.en: From Su Shi's famous Mid-Autumn ci of 1076, written in Mizhou in memory of his brother Su Zhe. The lines come just after 我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒.
story.zh: 苏轼1076年中秋在密州所作，怀念弟弟苏辙；这两句紧接“我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒”。

usage.en: Quoted for moonlit solitude and for preferring the real world to a lofty ideal. Mid-Autumn favourite.
usage.zh: 用于月夜独处，也表示更爱人间烟火；中秋常引。

text: 料得年年肠断处，明月夜，短松冈
pinyin: liào dé nián nián cháng duàn chù, míng yuè yè, duǎn sōng gāng
literal: reckon · get · year · year · bowels · break · place, bright · moon · night, short · pine · ridge
natural: I know the place where my heart breaks each year: a moonlit night, a ridge of short pines

meaning.en: I can imagine the place where, year after year, my heart would break: the moonlit night, the ridge with its small pines where she lies.
meaning.zh: 料想她年年伤心断肠的地方，就是那明月之夜、长着矮松的山冈。写对亡妻的思念。

equivalents: a grave visited with a broken heart every year

examples.zh: 清明扫墓时，他想起“料得年年肠断处，明月夜，短松冈”。
examples.en: Sweeping the grave at Qingming, he thought of 'I know where my heart breaks each year: a moonlit night, a ridge of small pines'.

examples.zh: 悼亡的文章结尾引用了“料得年年肠断处，明月夜，短松冈”。
examples.en: The elegy closes with 'the place where my heart breaks each year: a moonlit night, the pine-clad ridge'.

origin.source: 苏轼《江城子·乙卯正月二十日夜记梦》

story.en: Su Shi dreamt of his first wife Wang Fu, who had died ten years earlier, and wrote this ci in Mizhou in 1075.
story.zh: 1075年苏轼在密州梦见十年前去世的妻子王弗，作此词。

usage.en: Quoted when mourning a spouse. Su Shi's poem begins with 十年生死两茫茫，不思量，自难忘.
usage.zh: 用于悼念亡妻（夫）；全词开头为“十年生死两茫茫，不思量，自难忘”。

text: 蒌蒿满地芦芽短，正是河豚欲上时
pinyin: lóu hāo mǎn dì lú yá duǎn, zhèng shì hé tún yù shàng shí
literal: artemisia · fill · ground · reed · shoots · short, just · be · puffer-fish · about-to · ascend · time
natural: artemisia covers the ground, the reed shoots are short, just when the puffer-fish are about to run upstream

meaning.en: Artemisia covers the ground and the reed shoots are still short: it is just the time when the pufferfish swim upriver in early spring.
meaning.zh: 蒌蒿遍地，芦苇刚发短芽，正是河豚溯江而上的时节。描绘早春的景象与时令美食。

equivalents: early spring on the riverbank

examples.zh: 扬州的春天，真是“蒌蒿满地芦芽短，正是河豚欲上时”。
examples.en: Spring in Yangzhou is just like 'artemisia all over the ground, reed shoots short, the pufferfish about to run'.

examples.zh: 美食节的宣传语写着“蒌蒿满地芦芽短，正是河豚欲上时”。
examples.en: The food festival's slogan reads 'artemisia over the ground, short reed shoots, the time the puffer-fish run'.

story.en: Su Shi's inscription for a painting by the monk Huichong, which opens '竹外桃花三两枝，春江水暖鸭先知'.
story.zh: 苏轼为惠崇和尚所画《春江晚景》题的诗，前两句为“竹外桃花三两枝，春江水暖鸭先知”。

usage.en: Quoted for early spring and for seasonal river food. The pufferfish (河豚) is a delicacy but its organs are poisonous.
usage.zh: 用于描绘早春景色和时令河鲜；河豚味美但内脏有毒。

text: 马作的卢飞快，弓如霹雳弦惊
pinyin: mǎ zuò dí lú fēi kuài, gōng rú pī lì xián jīng
literal: horse · be · Dilu · fly · fast, bow · like · thunderclap · string · startle
natural: the horse is a Dilu, flying fast; the bow is like a thunderclap, its string startling

meaning.en: My horse is a swift Dilu that flies along, and the bowstring twangs like a thunderclap that startles all who hear it.
meaning.zh: 战马像的卢马一样飞奔，弓弦一响如霹雳般惊人。描写战场上的英勇与迅疾。

equivalents: a horse that flies and a bow that thunders

examples.zh: 球场上他速度惊人，解说员说像“马作的卢飞快，弓如霹雳弦惊”。
examples.en: He was astonishingly quick on the pitch, and the commentator likened him to 'a horse swift as Dilu, a bow like thunder'.

examples.zh: 阅兵式的解说词引用了“马作的卢飞快，弓如霹雳弦惊”。
examples.en: The parade commentary quoted 'the horse is a swift Dilu, the bowstring like a thunderclap'.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《破阵子·为陈同甫赋壮词以寄之》

story.en: Xin Qiji's ci sent to his friend Chen Liang (Tongfu), a stirring recollection of army life that ends with the bitter 可怜白发生. Dilu was the horse of Liu Bei.
story.zh: 辛弃疾写给好友陈亮（同甫）的壮词，回忆军旅生涯，结尾是“可怜白发生”的感慨；的卢是刘备的名马。

usage.en: Quoted for martial vigour and speed. 的卢 is the famed horse of Liu Bei in the Three Kingdoms period. Note 的 here is read dí.
usage.zh: 用于形容战场的英勇与迅疾；的卢是刘备的名马，的读dí。

text: 醉里吴音相媚好，白发谁家翁媪
pinyin: zuì lǐ wú yīn xiāng mèi hǎo, bái fà shéi jiā wēng ǎo
literal: drunk · in · Wu · speech · mutually · charming · good, white · hair · whose · home · old-man · old-woman
natural: tipsy, I hear the soft Wu dialect, so sweet: whose family are these white-haired old man and wife?

meaning.en: Slightly drunk, I hear a pleasantly soft Wu dialect: who is that white-haired old couple?
meaning.zh: 喝得微醉，听到吴地口音软糯动听，是谁家的白发老夫妻在聊天呢？描绘农村老人的和睦闲适。

equivalents: a peaceful rural scene of an old couple

examples.zh: 在江南小镇，他听着老人们软软的乡音，念起“醉里吴音相媚好，白发谁家翁媪”。
examples.en: In a small Jiangnan town, listening to the old people's soft local speech, he thought of 'tipsy, I hear the sweet Wu accent: whose old couple are these?'

examples.zh: 摄影展的村居专题引用了“醉里吴音相媚好，白发谁家翁媪”。
examples.en: The village-life section of the photo show quoted 'tipsy, I hear the sweet Wu tongue: whose white-haired old couple?'

story.en: Xin Qiji wrote this while living in the countryside at Shangrao in Jiangxi; the ci opens '茅檐低小，溪上青青草' and ends with the youngest son lying by the stream shelling lotus seeds.
story.zh: 辛弃疾闲居江西上饶乡间所作，开头为“茅檐低小，溪上青青草”，结尾写小儿子溪头剥莲蓬。

usage.en: Quoted for a gentle rural scene and the harmony of old couples. 翁媪 (wēng ǎo) means old man and old woman.
usage.zh: 用于描绘乡村恬静生活和老夫妻和睦；翁媪指老翁和老妇。

text: 试问卷帘人，却道海棠依旧
pinyin: shì wèn juàn lián rén, què dào hǎi táng yī jiù
literal: try · ask · roll-up · curtain · person, yet · say · crab-apple · as-ever
natural: I ask the maid rolling up the curtain; she says the crab-apple is just as it was

meaning.en: I ask the girl who is rolling up the curtain about the garden, and she says the crab-apple blossoms are just as before: she cannot see what the wind and rain did to them.
meaning.zh: 试着问正在卷帘的侍女，她却说海棠花依然如旧。词人知道经过风雨，花必然已凋零。

equivalents: blind to the change before one's eyes

examples.zh: 侍女只答“试问卷帘人，却道海棠依旧”，词人的惆怅无人理解。
examples.en: Asked about the garden, the maid says only that it is as ever, so the poet's wistfulness goes unshared, as in 'I ask the curtain-raiser, who says the crab-apple is as before'.

examples.zh: 文学课上，老师用“试问卷帘人，却道海棠依旧”分析对话的妙处。
examples.en: In literature class the teacher used 'I ask the one rolling up the curtain, who says the crab-apple is as before' to show the beauty of dialogue in poetry.

story.en: Li Qingzhao's tiny ci begins with 昨夜雨疏风骤，浓睡不消残酒, then this exchange with the maid, and closes with 知否，知否？应是绿肥红瘦.
story.zh: 李清照的小令，起句为“昨夜雨疏风骤，浓睡不消残酒”，接着是与侍女的问答，结句“知否，知否？应是绿肥红瘦”。

usage.en: Followed by the famous 知否，知否？应是绿肥红瘦 (already an entry). Quoted for how differently people perceive change.
usage.zh: 下句为著名的“知否，知否？应是绿肥红瘦”（已另有词条）；用于说明人对变化的不同感受。
